title: Sub-Scope Report List Filter Delivery
summary: add a search-style local list filter to docs_subscope using only its already loaded manifest or management inventory
content_html:
Sub-Scope Report List Filter Delivery

Status And Order

Proposed as SSI-4, after Sub-Scope Package Preparation Delivery. Implementation has not started.

SSI-4 is a shared report improvement. It does not widen SSI-2 Delete, SSI-3 package preparation, or the Docs Viewer search subsystem.

Complete Outcome

The docs_subscope list view offers a search-style input that filters its already loaded collection records, like the local filter on Tag Registry.

Filtering is immediate and client-side:

public: loaded manifest records
manage: supplied management-inventory records

It issues no search request, builds no index, fetches no by-ID payload for matching, and does not make the child collection a separate search surface.

Data And Matching Boundary

The report retains the complete loaded collection as source state and derives a filtered row projection from it.

  • Match only fields present in both projections: doc_id and title.
  • Treat the query case-insensitively with normalized whitespace.
  • An empty query shows the complete loaded collection.
  • Status, viewability, body content, metadata not present in the manifest, and rendered detail HTML are not search inputs.
  • The public manifest and manage inventory remain unchanged.

The exact token/substring rule and clear-control behavior are frozen at SSI-4.0 against realistic IDs and titles before UI implementation.

Report State

  • Filter state belongs to one mounted { scope, sub_scope } report instance.
  • Opening a filtered row and returning to the same list preserves the query.
  • Changing collection or unmounting the report clears it.
  • Filtering does not add URL state or change subdoc.
  • The list status distinguishes matching rows from total loaded rows and provides a contained no-match state.
  • Detail validation continues to use the complete loaded collection, not only the currently visible rows.

Selection Interaction

SSI-4 follows SSI-3 so filtering must compose with collection selection:

  • filtering never silently checks, unchecks, or prunes IDs;
  • checked IDs remain the only package-action target even when a checked row is filtered out;
  • Select all replaces the checked set with all currently visible eligible matching rows, clearing any checked IDs excluded by the filter; and
  • Clear still clears the complete collection selection.

These rules keep filtering presentational and prevent a query from broadening or silently changing a mutation/export target.

In Scope

  • One accessible search-style list filter in the shared report.
  • Local matching over already loaded doc_id and title values.
  • Matching/total count, clear, empty, no-match, detail-return, and remount behavior.
  • Public and manage parity without a management import.
  • Composition with the delivered contribution and selection boundaries.
  • Focused pure filter, report-module, public-isolation, and realistic list evidence.

Not In Scope

  • Docs Viewer overall search or build_search.py.
  • A sub-scope-specific search index, endpoint, route, or results page.
  • Full-text body search or eager by-ID loading.
  • Server-side pagination, ranking, highlighting, fuzzy matching, or saved queries.
  • Filtering the parent Index, Recent, scope selector, or another report type.

Delivery Tracker

[ ] SSI-4.0 — Freeze Local Filter Semantics

  • [ ] Confirm the shared/public and manage record shapes.
  • [ ] Freeze normalization, matching, count, clear, and no-match behavior.
  • [ ] Freeze visible eligible IDs as the Select all input against the shipped SSI-3 contract.
  • [ ] Capture ordinary, empty, missing-title, non-viewable, detail-return, and large-list baselines.

Review gate: approve filter and selection semantics before report edits.

[ ] SSI-4.1 — Add Shared Report Filtering

  • [ ] Add the filter control and pure row projection to docs_subscope.
  • [ ] Preserve the complete loaded collection for validation and selection.
  • [ ] Preserve query state across detail and Back within one mounted collection.
  • [ ] Render truthful counts and contained empty/no-match states.
  • [ ] Keep public and manage behavior on the same shared implementation.

Review gate: module evidence proves local-only filtering without new reads or search imports.

[ ] SSI-4.2 — Integration And Closeout

  • [ ] Verify filtering with contribution rows and selection controls.
  • [ ] Verify Select all includes every visible eligible row and no filtered-out ID.
  • [ ] Confirm public imports and requests remain unchanged.
  • [ ] Review ordinary, narrow, keyboard, clear, no-match, and filtered-selection behavior.
  • [ ] Run the focused report and maintained Docs Viewer integration checks.
  • [ ] Record untested scale and tactile surfaces.

Completion Gate

SSI-4 is complete only when users can narrow the loaded sub-scope list without creating another search subsystem or changing the collection/action target.
